training_reference.scope: V5.3 conservative recovery after V5.2 regressed from 18/27 to 4/27 cases
training_reference.height_shape: Fixed original exponential plus quadratic height reward; no changing kernel, weight or rotation cap
training_reference.optimization: Fixed 3e-5 learning rate with 50-update critic warmup; initial exploration floor reduced from 0.08 to 0.03
training_reference.rehearsal: Half of flat samples reserved for 16 groups covering the original 18 passing cases
training_reference.regression: Initial 18 anchors must pass; two consecutive 250-update evaluations losing anchors stop the run, including optimizer resume
training_reference.recovery: Restore original candidate actor; do not resume the degraded V5.2 optimizer or adaptive curriculum
training_reference.performance_window: Disabled for this stationary-objective recovery experiment
training_reference.causality: Conservative combined rollback; isolated causal contributions remain unproven
